title: Strawberry Basil Spritz
description: Fresh muddled strawberries and basil with lime and sparkling water. Light, refreshing, and naturally sweetened. Works as a mocktail or with a splash of something stronger.

ingredients.name: sparkling water, to top each glass

instructions.text: Divide the chopped strawberries evenly among four glasses. Add 2 tablespoons of lime juice to each glass along with 2-3 roughly torn basil leaves.
Using a cocktail muddler, pound the strawberries and basil until they release their juices. Add monk fruit sweetener if using.
Fill each glass with ice, top with sparkling water, and stir. Garnish with a fresh basil leaf and serve immediately.

notes: Monk fruit sweetener keeps this sugar-free; skip it entirely if your strawberries are ripe and sweet. A splash of vodka, gin, or prosecco works well if you want to make it a cocktail. Best made fresh -- muddled strawberries don't hold well.
